NOT FOUND.

What I searched:
- Searched the suppliers folder (all files named supplier-agreement-005.docx through supplier-agreement-120.docx, plus supplier-agreement-acme.docx, -borealis.docx, -corvid.docx, -dunmore.docx) for terms: "most-favoured", "most-favored", "most favoured nation", "MFN", "most fav", "most favoured nation pricing", and related price/“best price”/“price match” phrases.

What I inspected:
- Opened supplier-agreement-acme.docx, supplier-agreement-borealis.docx and supplier-agreement-corvid.docx and checked Pricing clauses. Each has Clause 6 (Pricing) stating: "Unit prices are subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by the consumer price index and capped at four percent." No most‑favoured‑nation or MFN language appears in those documents.

Because no supplier agreement in the suppliers folder contained MFN/most‑favoured‑nation pricing language based on those searches and inspections, I cannot identify a supplier agreement that contains such a clause.
